top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Minimum Height of 22 Inches from Top of Railing to Mattress Support at Lowest Level (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(E))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A bassinet was observed at inspection as sleep equipment for a 6 month old infant. The manufacturer instructions specifies this sleep equipment is for 0-5 month olds. Additionally, a bassinet of 11.5 inches in height from the sleep surface to the top of the rail does not meet the play yard guidelines of at least 22 inches required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child needs emergency care authorization to be redone due to water damage on form.

top_violation_types.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A large unmounted fan was accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the director turned off the fan and removed it from the area.
